summary: Release managed OMP messages when foreground work is positively idle while background jobs continue.

replay.detail: No claim replay or history rewriting.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Existing message ownership and receipt rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The managed OMP hook samples positive idle after continuing agent_end events and checks fresh idle before holding incoming mail. Human-blocking guards and session-generation fences remain intact.

downtime.detail: This source change does not stop or replace existing seats.

manual.detail: No manual state migration is required.

recovery.detail: Newly loaded hooks release held messages after positive foreground idle without declaring background jobs terminal. Existing loaded hooks are not modified and have no new release-held control operation.
